description: Defines structures and functions for delta encoding, including creating, freeing, and applying delta indexes and data, as well as calculating delta sizes and header information.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Computes index data from a given buffer for delta operations.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a delta index.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Returns the memory usage of a delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Creates a delta from a delta index and a buffer, with size constraints.

methods.name: diff_delta
methods.description: Creates a delta between source and target buffers.

methods.name: patch_delta
methods.description: Recreates the target buffer from source buffer and delta data.

methods.name: get_delta_hdr_size
methods.description: Calculates the size from delta header data, called twice to get source and target sizes.
